description: Due to an accident, at least 550 locals must be moved across a lake. They can either be transported over the lake by a kayak or a motorboat. Kayaks can transport 4 people every trip and motorboats can transport 5 people every trip. Kayaks take 5 minutes per trip whereas motorboats take 3 minutes per trip. Due to the limited number of motorboats available to the locals, there can be at most 25 motorboat trips and at least 75% of the trips should be by kayak. How many of each transportation method should be used to minimize the total amount of time needed to transport all the locals?

MinLocals.definition: Minimum number of locals to transport

KayakCapacity.definition: Number of people a kayak can transport per trip

MotorboatCapacity.definition: Number of people a motorboat can transport per trip

KayakTime.definition: Time in minutes a kayak takes per trip

MotorboatTime.definition: Time in minutes a motorboat takes per trip

MaxMotorboatTrips.definition: Maximum number of motorboat trips allowed

MinKayakTripPercentage.definition: Minimum percentage of trips that must be by kayak

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required to transport at least 550 locals across the lake using kayaks and motorboats"

constraints.description: 4 * (number of kayak trips) + 5 * (number of motorboat trips) >= 550
Number of kayak trips >= 3 * (number of motorboat trips)
Number of kayak trips and number of motorboat trips must be integers

KayakTrips.definition: Number of kayak trips used to transport locals

MotorboatTrips.definition: Number of motorboat trips used to transport locals
